- Add 50MB upload size note

Implement User Story 3: Add SCORM management to the course edit form.

Branch: story/025-admin-courses-management
Constitution: III (Module Boundaries)

Files to modify:

1. src/Host/Pages/Admin/Courses/Edit.cshtml.cs
- Inject ScormPackageService alongside existing CourseCatalogService
- Add [BindProperty]: ScormFile (IFormFile?), ScormMode (string?)
- Add CurrentScormPackage property (ScormPackage?) for display
- In OnGetAsync: load course by ID, populate fields, also load current SCORM via ScormPackageService.GetPackageByCourseIdAsync(courseId)
- In OnPostAsync: (a) call CourseCatalogService.UpdateAsync(courseId, new UpdateCourseRequest(...)), (b) if ScormFile provided and course has SCORM, call ScormPackageService.ReplacePackageAsync(courseId, ScormFile.OpenReadStream()), (c) if ScormFile provided and no SCORM, call ScormPackageService.UploadAsync(ScormFile.OpenReadStream(), courseId), (d) redirect to Index with success

- Keep existing form for Title, ShortDescription, FullDescription, Category, Duration
- Add SCORM section after Duration:

- Enforce 50MB max file size
